text.tspan: Autonomous surveillance system detecting PPE, hardhats, and
safety vests in high-risk zones with sub-second incident alerts.
Intelligent pipeline leveraging LLMs to draft, schedule, and publish
cross-platform content with tone alignment and analytics.
Semantic parser and ranking engine evaluating structured resumes
against competency matrices using dense vector embeddings.
Interactive clinical assistant allowing patients to communicate symptoms
via conversational speech with structured clinical triage.
Social stream sentiment classification engine deployed as containerized
REST API processing high-volume text streams into signals.
Learning coordination portal with automated session scheduling,
assignment delivery, progress tracking, and mentor channels.
